title: Solomon Thomas will rejoin Robert Saleh after trade from Cowboys

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Solomon Thomas will rejoin Robert Saleh after trade from Cowboys
sources.description: The Cowboys have made a second trade on Wednesday, sending defensive lineman Solomon Thomas to the Titans, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
